JWT Decoder

Decode any JWT to inspect its header and payload claims — with an honest note that signatures are not verified.

–
Algorithm
–
Expiry verdict

      

      

        
        

      

    

    

      
    

    

    
Signature is NOT verified. This tool only decodes — it cannot tell you whether the token is authentic. Never trust a token just because it decodes.

  

  




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Paste a JWT (header.payload.signature) into the box.
  2. The header and payload decode instantly into readable JSON.
  3. Standard claims like exp, iat and iss are translated into plain dates.
  4. Remember: decoding is not verification — the signature is never checked.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does this verify the JWT signature?
No. This tool only decodes the base64url payload so you can read it. Verification needs the signing key, which this tool never sees.
Is the data inside a JWT encrypted?
Anyone holding the token can read its payload, so never put passwords, API keys or other secrets inside a JWT.
How do I try it without a real token?
Paste the token into the box or press “Load sample” to try the decoder on an example token.
